outcomes.name: a signed-out visitor is sent to the sign-in page
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 1: A signed-out visitor who opens `/` or `/orders` ends up on the sign-in page (`/login`). It shows the heading "Sign in", an Email field, a Password field and a "Sign in" button, and no order information.

outcomes.name: signing in shows my three orders
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 2: Signing in with the test account takes the user to `/orders`. The page shows the heading "Your orders", "Signed in as" followed by the account's email, and the three orders in the order above, each like "#2001 Standing desk $480". Account data: "The test account has three orders: #2001 Standing desk $480, #2002 Desk mat $35, #2003 Webcam $120."

outcomes.name: a wrong password is refused and leaves me signed out
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 3: A wrong password puts the user back on the sign-in page with an alert reading "Wrong email or password". The user is not signed in: opening `/orders` sends them to the sign-in page again.

outcomes.name: an unknown email or empty fields get the same refusal
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 4: An unknown email, or empty fields, give the same alert as a wrong password, so nothing reveals whether an email has an account.

outcomes.name: reloading my orders keeps me signed in
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 5: Reloading `/orders` while signed in keeps the user signed in.

outcomes.name: signing out locks my orders again
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 6: The orders page has a "Sign out" button. Using it returns the user to the sign-in page, and opening `/orders` afterwards sends them there again.
